name: BetweenUs
summary: End-to-end encrypted, Discord-style messaging and calls for desktop, web and Android. Eight NestJS services behind Nginx. Messages are encrypted on the client with AES-256-GCM, so the server stores only ciphertext. Calls use a peer-to-peer WebRTC mesh with no media server.
stack: NestJS, TypeScript, Electron, React, Jetpack Compose, WebRTC, PostgreSQL, Redis

name: Aiyu
summary: The portfolio and CMS behind [me.aiyu.co.in](https://me.aiyu.co.in/). 52 themes, a Markdown blog with Notion sync, a LaTeX resume editor, a visual cron scheduler with encrypted secrets, and an MCP server.
stack: Next.js 16, React 19, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Gemini, Docker

name: Findex
summary: Android file manager with multi-tab and dual-pane browsing, a storage analyzer, duplicate finder, cleaner, archive tools and a recycle bin. Privacy-focused.

name: Pull
summary: Android download manager. Segmented multi-connection HTTP, torrents and magnet links, video sites through yt-dlp, and a built-in browser with an ad blocker.

name: Kinema
summary: Self-hosted media server, a lightweight alternative to Plex and Jellyfin. Direct play first, near-zero idle CPU, TMDB metadata and family profiles. Runs on a Raspberry Pi.

name: Domus
summary: Local-first smart-home hub. Tuya, Tapo, Xiaomi, Hue and MQTT/Zigbee2MQTT devices, a built-in Matter bridge for Google Home, Apple Home and Alexa, energy bill tracking and automations.

name: Switchboard
summary: Control your PC from your phone: brightness and contrast for every monitor over DDC/CI, volume, media playback and power. End-to-end encrypted on your own network, paired by QR code.

name: Rewire
summary: Android app that reduces unwanted habits by adding intentional friction before distracting apps open. It creates a pause, lets you choose, and shows your own patterns. No punishment, no surveillance.
